title: Rubric: Acoustic Synchronization of Dha (Ge + Na Compound Stroke)

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-01
criteria.description: Step 1: The flat wrist heel slide on the Bayan (Ge) and the index finger rim strike on the Dayan (Na) must impact within +/- 15ms. [source_claim_id: CLM-01]
criteria.observable_indicator: The flat wrist heel slide on the Bayan (Ge) and the index finger rim strike on the Dayan (Na) must impact within +/- 15ms.

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-02
criteria.description: Step 2: Simultaneous strike generates a composite acoustic spectrum combining 85Hz bass modulation with 440Hz ringing harmonic overtone. [source_claim_id: CLM-02]
criteria.observable_indicator: Simultaneous strike generates a composite acoustic spectrum combining 85Hz bass modulation with 440Hz ringing harmonic overtone.
